_readme: Per-symbol dated catalysts. When the watcher sees a symbol here with catalyst_date within lookahead_days, it multiplies the adaptive trail % and hard-stop drop by catalyst_mult so the position survives normal noise up to the event. After catalyst_date passes, the entry is ignored (falls back to default adaptive stops). Add/remove entries as your book changes.

VERA.note: Atacicept BLA priority-review PDUFA. Binary event; expect 40-70% one-day move.
